definitions.explanation: Dried tobacco leaves or a cigarette for smoking.

たばこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|や}めたい→やめる：00909_yameru⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧たばこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|や}めた→やめる：00909_yameru⟧。
examples.english: My father quit smoking last year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧たばこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}って→吸う：04394_suu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
たばこ means tobacco or cigarette. Can be written in hiragana, katakana (タバコ), or kanji ({煙草|たばこ}).

ETYMOLOGY:
From Portuguese "tabaco."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- たばこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}う→吸う：04394_suu⟧: to smoke
- たばこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|や}める→やめる：00909_yameru⟧: to quit smoking
- たばこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy cigarettes

- ⟦{喫煙所|きつえんじょ}→喫煙所：07043_kitsuenjo⟧: smoking area

CULTURAL NOTE:
Smoking restrictions have increased in Japan. Many public spaces are now ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧ (no smoking).
